rules.description: Editor cold load to interactive on a warm cache, measured on an unthrottled CI/headless runner at desktop viewport. Carries NO device signal: it is the runner, not a desktop. The brief's 3s desktop ceiling is applied to it as an upper bound, but the real desktop claim is DEVICE-VERIFIED and deferred.

Editor cold load to interactive on a warm cache, tablet profile under 4x requested CPU throttling. Throttled emulation, not tablet hardware. The slowdown actually achieved varies by host and contention and is recorded per measurement as throttleRatio; the gate rejects a measurement whose evidence falls below the ratio this ceiling needs to be meaningful.

Editor cold load to interactive on a warm cache, phone profile under 6x requested CPU throttling. Throttled emulation, not phone hardware. The slowdown actually achieved varies by host and contention and is recorded per measurement as throttleRatio; the gate rejects a measurement whose evidence falls below the ratio this ceiling needs to be meaningful.
Engine runtime bundle, gzipped, excluding editor and user assets.
Fraction of frames that missed a vsync on the reference 2D scene, tablet profile. The brief's 60fps target, stated as something the instrument can express a pass for.
rules.source: Brief P1 gate, restated: a p95 rAF interval can never read 60fps even on an empty page, so the original min:60 was unsatisfiable by any engine. Deferred to P9 because it needs a GPU: CI renders through SwiftShader, where the throttled tablet profile drops frames with one entity on screen. See ADR-0015, GAP-011, DV-007 and RC-0012; the CI-measurable half is playmode.cpuFrame.tablet.reference2d.

rules.description: Engine CPU work per 60Hz frame on the reference 2D scene, tablet profile: one simulation step plus one scene-graph update and draw submission. Rasterisation is excluded and this makes no GPU claim.
rules.source: Derived: half of a 16.67ms 60Hz frame, rounded down. The other half must cover rasterisation, compositing and the gameplay a real project adds. Measured at 4.66ms (0.26ms per step + 4.40ms per frame). A shippability bound catching regressions of about 1.7x and larger; run-to-run variance on the sub-millisecond components is roughly 2x on this host, so nothing tighter is achievable here. See ADR-0015 and RC-0011.

rules.description: Sustained play-mode frame rate floor on the reference 3D scene, phone profile.
Worst single frame time observed during scene manipulation in the editor.
Peak JS heap during play mode, phone profile. Excludes GPU memory, which JS cannot observe.
Texture and GPU buffer bytes resident, phone profile, accounted by the asset loader.
Ratio of end-of-soak heap to post-warmup heap over a 30 minute play-mode run. Above 1.0 by more than the slack indicates a leak.
Editor application shell, gzipped: every emitted JS and CSS asset, less source maps and less the engine runtime chunk. The two budgets are disjoint and must stay so.
